sources.snippet: 6 Conclusion We have presented a formal, integrated framework for guiding the development of AI into truly autonomous, self-improving intelligences. This blueprint provides a unified semantic space for the intelligence to coherently represent and regulate its own action, judgment, learning, and self-transformation.

sources.title: PDF Self-Supervised Learning - Stanford University
sources.snippet: Can self-supervised learning help? Self-supervised learning (informal definition): supervise using labels generated from the data without any manual or as weak label sources Idea: Hide or modify part of the input. Ask model to recover input or classify what changed. Self-supervised task referred to the pretext task

sources.title: Self-Supervised Theorem Discovery in a Formal Axiomatic System
sources.snippet: We propose a self-supervised theorem-discovery algo-rithm that grows a theorem library from the primitive rules of a Hilbert axiom system and then reuses ex-tracted theorems as lemmas for further proof search. Our experiments show that our agent discovers tens of thousands of theorems and finds proofs for human-written benchmark problems.

sources.title: Self-Supervised Theorem Discovery in a Formal Axiomatic System

Many existing approaches, including large language models (LLMs), draw on human prior knowledge in the form of mathematical text, code, or theorem libraries.
